title: Run full anti-pattern scan on src/
action: Scan entire src/ directory for TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX markers. Document or resolve any new findings beyond the 3 known TODOs already fixed.

criteria: grep -rc 'TODO\|FIXME\|HACK\|XXX' src/ — if count > 0, each finding documented with justification

implementation: Run grep -rn 'TODO\|FIXME\|HACK\|XXX' src/ after Wave 1 fixes are applied. Known items resolved by TASK-001 and TASK-003. For any new findings: if trivial, fix inline; if substantial, document in plan summary with justification for deferral.
